args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for money rounding per FIN-212

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` uses ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, fixing the failing test:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

CI passed on the branch.
